title: Cost observatory
idea: Cost observatory: Measured usage and unit prices expose cost drivers and freshness
audience: People who need to review cost within a dashboard surface.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic instrument layout through its review cost priority and explicit commitment contract: Forecasts and billed actuals remain distinct
navigation: Cost observatory keeps the current review cost context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Measured usage and unit prices expose cost drivers and freshness
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to review cost; operators optimize actual recurring costs
composition.priority: Forecasts and billed actuals remain distinct

imagery.role: Support the actual review cost context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Keep time range and unit definitions near every measure
Keep units, filters and selection understandable at narrow widths; expose a focused item view.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the cost observatory structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no review cost content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Forecasts and billed actuals remain distinct
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized review cost content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Forecasts and billed actuals remain distinct
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active review cost context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure bounded queries and large-data interaction; virtualize only with accessible alternatives.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
